title: Tožilnik: vidim brata, pijem kavo
description: The accusative after imam, vidim, čakam and rad imam: living masculine nouns take -a, things stay the same, feminine -a becomes -o.

quest.story: Mojca piše nalogo za šolo: 'Vidim brata, pijem kavo.' Pomagaj ji s končnicami. · Mojca is writing an exercise for school: 'I see the brother, I drink coffee.' Help her with the endings.

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.explain: A living masculine noun (a person or animal) takes -a as the object: brat → vidim brata.

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.explain: A masculine thing keeps its base form as the object: imam avto, vidim kruh. Only living beings take -a.

exercises.instruction: Izberi pravilno obliko · Pick the right form
exercises.explain: Feminine -a → -o as the object: kava → pijem kavo, juha → jem juho.

exercises.instruction: Katere povedi so pravilne? · Which sentences are correct?
exercises.explain: The object changes: mama → mamo, kava → kavo, brat → brata. The base form stays only for masculine things.
Krompir is a masculine thing, so the object looks like the base form: {m:rad|f:rada} imam krompir.

exercises.text: Vsak dan vidim ___. (Every day I see grandma.)
exercises.explain: babica → babico. Vsak dan = every day.
stric → strica: living masculine noun, -a. No preposition needed after čakam.
oče → očeta: the -t- appears in every form except the base one (očeta, očetu, očetje).
juha → juho. {m:A woman says rada imam.|f:A man says rad imam.}
Avtobus is a thing, so it keeps its base form. Čakam avtobusa would mean a living bus.

exercises.prompt: I have a brother and a sister.

exercises.instruction: Povej po slovensko · Say it in Slovene
exercises.prompt: Say that you like coffee and bread.
exercises.explain: kava → kavo, but kruh stays kruh: a masculine thing.
